To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) response-based learning improves SMT by up to 6 points in terms of precision and recall; and (2) response-based learning is a promising new paradigm for learning from extrinsic supervision signals.

response-based learning is a novel approach for statistical machine trans- lation that allows to extract supervisory signals for structured learning of SMT models from an extrinsic re- sponse to a translation input.
we propose a novel learning method for SMT that allows to extract supervised signals from an extrinsic task response to a translation.
